summary.text: Charlie Hartz is a Republican state representative from Aiken County who has represented South Carolina House District 81 since November 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

A self-employed business owner, Hartz serves on the Agriculture, Natural Resources and Environmental Affairs Committee and the Regulations, Administrative Procedures, Artificial Intelligence and Cybersecurity Committee.

paragraphs.text: Hartz was born in Rochester, New York, and graduated from Alfred University with a B.A. in 1981.
His legislative biography lists him as chair of the chamber of commerce in 2018 and 2024, a board member of the Aiken Corporation and United Way, and a commissioner of Aiken Technical College.
Hartz took office on November 11, 2024, succeeding Bart Blackwell.
In the November 3 general election he faces Democrat Pete Swales.
